name: Anaheim Fire and Rescue Explorer Program
what_you_do: Learn basic fire and life-saving skills with Anaheim firefighters. Meetings mix fitness, class time and skills practice. After six months you can ride along on fire engines and ambulances.
who_can_apply: Ages 15 to 21. If you are 15, you must have finished 8th grade. You must keep a GPA of 2.0 or higher and be able to run, lift, climb and crawl.
pay_detail: Not stated on the program page.
duration: Meetings every other Tuesday, 5:30 to 9:00 p.m.
deadline_text: No dates are posted. Join the interest list to hear when spots open.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Fire Explorers Interest Form on the program page. You will be told when spots open. Email FireExplorer@anaheim.net with questions.
notes: Spots go first to Public Safety Pathways grads. Then to Anaheim residents. Then to Anaheim students. Explorers do not enter burning buildings. They do not replace firefighters.
